```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₂} D] {G : CategoryTheory.Functor D C} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D} (adj : F ⊣ G) (A : adj.toMonad.Algebra) : G.IsSplitPair (F.map A.a) (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) := by
  constructor
  -- First, show that F.map A.a is a section of adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)
  apply (adj.toMonad.Algebra.hom_ext _ _ _)
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_comp_map_eq_iff adj]
    exact (adj.toMonad.Algebra.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (adj.toMonad.Algebra.unit_app _).symm
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.eq_unit_comp_map_iff adj]
    exact (adj.toMonad.Algebra.assoc _ _ _).trans (adj.toMonad.Algebra.unit_app _)
  -- Second, show that adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A) is a retraction of F.map A.a
  apply (adj.toMonad.Algebra.hom_ext _ _ _)
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_comp_map_eq_iff adj]
    exact (adj.toMonad.Algebra.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (adj.toMonad.Algebra.counit_app _)
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.eq_unit_comp_map_iff adj]
    exact (adj.toMonad.Algebra.assoc _ _ _).trans (adj.toMonad.Algebra.counit_app _)
```
